request.style: English, romantic ballad, male and female duet, piano, strings, acoustic guitar, soft drums, tender and warm, 68 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the garden at the dawn of days the LORD God looked and said
It is not good for the man to be alone
He made a helper suitable, and the man awoke and saw
This one at last is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh

[Verse]
So here we stand together in the presence of the LORD
With the people that we love around us and a promise in our hands
That is why a man leaves his father and mother
And holds fast to his wife, and they become one flesh

[Chorus]
Set me as a seal upon your heart
As a seal upon your arm
For love is as strong as death
Many waters cannot quench love
Nor can rivers wash it away

[Bridge]
Two are better than one
If one of them falls, the other can lift him up
And if two lie down together, they keep warm
Though someone may overpower one alone, two can stand against him
And a cord of three strands is not easily broken

[Chorus]
Set me as a seal upon your heart
As a seal upon your arm
For love is as strong as death
Many waters cannot quench love
Nor can rivers wash it away

[Outro]
A cord of three strands
Is not easily broken
